translations.web: The highways are desolate. The traveling man ceases. The covenant is broken. He has despised the cities. He doesn’t respect man.
translations.bsb: The highways are deserted; travel has ceased. The treaty has been broken, the witnesses are despised, and human life is disregarded.
translations.kjv: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceaseth: he hath broken the covenant, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth no man.
translations.asv: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceaseth: the enemy hath broken the covenant, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth not man.
